theorems.statement: ∀ (P n d : ℕ) (c : Covector (Euclid P) n ≃L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (m : Set (Euclid P) → ℝ), (∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, covectorEuclideanNorm α = ‖c α‖) → (∀ (W : Set (Euclid P)) (ω : TestFormOn U n) (r : ℝ), IsOpen W → CompactlyContained W U → tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) ⊆ W → (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ≤ r) → |T ω| ≤ r * m W) → ∃ Φ : (Euclid P → Covector (Euclid P) n) → ℝ, ∀ (G : Euclid P → Covector (Euclid P) n) (W : Set (Euclid P)) (ωs : ℕ → TestFormOn U n) (εs : ℕ → ℝ), IsOpen W → CompactlyContained W U → (∀ k, tsupport (ωs k : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) ⊆ W) → (∀ k x, covectorEuclideanNorm ((ωs k : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x - G x) ≤ εs k) → Tendsto εs atTop (𝓝 0) → Tendsto (fun k => T (ωs k)) atTop (𝓝 (Φ G))
